title: Single-Use Bureau-Runtime-Refresh after PR #2158 for Bureau-05 unblock
goal: Execute exactly one new target-bound Bureau runtime refresh to the freshly observed protected heimgewebe/bureau main after this authority itself is merged as one create-only TaskSpec and adopted missing-only into the authoritative StateStore. The sole purpose is to converge the immutable Bureau runtime from deployed source 4f88a8faf995a25c2d58336bc59328750654e5f2 with current canonical main after PR #2158 so canonical pickup and unblocker work can resume. This authority grants no queue, claim, dispatch, product-code, foreign-work or general repository authority.

approval.note: Single-use target-bound bootstrap only. The current explicit BUREAU-05 instruction authorizes autonomously fixing the highest-value real runtime-convergence blocker. No effect may start until fresh GitHub main/CI observation, exact target binding, authoritative TaskSpec preflight, typed source-ancestry precondition, live intent-bound leases and runtime-refresh readback gates all pass. Repeat the ancestry precondition immediately before apply. No blind retry after any effect-started ambiguity.

acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, GitHub main is freshly observed; the exact target contains this protected authority merge and all then-current legitimate main merges, and required validate (3.10) and validate (3.12) checks for that exact main revision are successful.

Immediately before prepare-intent and again immediately before apply, a typed precondition readback proves that the active deployment-manifest source_commit and canonical Registry source identity are equal, and that this active source is either exactly the registered deployed source 4f88a8faf995a25c2d58336bc59328750654e5f2 or a verified Git ancestor of the freshly selected target main commit. Any deployment/Registry identity mismatch, unrelated or diverged source history, unavailable ancestry proof, or target drift blocks the runtime effect fail-closed.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from attempt/result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launcher pair and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit, and bureau runtime-identity is integrity-valid at that exact target.

The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback and grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, Commonworld, RepoGround, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.

rollback.strategy: The currently integrity-valid deployed Bureau runtime remains authoritative until a new immutable result is fully read back. If the source-ancestry precondition fails or the new effect becomes unclear, preserve all precondition, attempt, intent, workspace, backup, manifest, Registry, authority and lease evidence and do not retry. Reconciliation requires a separately authorized successor path.
